verdict.rationale: Missive's own docs say one shared inbox handles email, SMS, WhatsApp and social accounts. The API reference documents WhatsApp messages flowing through conversations, and custom channels are listed as a developer tool. Live chat is never evidenced, and the docs on channel setup and depth are only brief one-line claims with no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: live chat support, detailed per-channel setup/feature documentation (SMS providers, which social networks), independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-channel use.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email

citations.quote: Manage email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more in one shared inbox.
For WhatsApp messages, the id in from_field and to_fields identifies authors and recipients by their Business-Scoped User ID (BSUID)
Missive developer tools: REST API, UI integrations, webhooks, and custom channels for full customization.
